input.name: viewer-only-page-cache
input.covers: Visible current page-space annotations load once; absent pages reject not-found. Object-number and base-index references keep stable ids. Hidden and noView are filtered; invisible and reply attachment survive.

input.name: viewer-only-malformed-lists
input.covers: Malformed Annotation records are outside the current typed engine boundary. Each page read refusal is observable as error status and can be retried; no malformed DTO is manufactured.

input.name: viewer-only-loads-in-flight
input.covers: A second ensureLoaded while a list is in flight joins it (v2 listed the page again). A refused list leaves the page unloaded, so the next ensureLoaded retries.

input.name: viewer-only-refetch-on-events
input.covers: Current create, update, reorder and delete facts refetch a loaded page; uncached pages and page rotation do not read. Closing releases subscriptions.

input.name: annotation-backed-source
input.covers: Current annotation mirror owns link items without page reads. Remote create/delete and local confirmed update/delete are immediately visible through the link capability.

input.name: hit-testing-and-lookup
input.covers: getLinkAt answers the smallest link whose bounds hold the point (edges included, the first of equal areas), null off every link; getLink finds a link by id or answers null. activateAt activates the link under the point with the page in its context, a Link input carrying its own ref and activate tree, and answers null off every link.

input.name: hit-testing-by-area
input.covers: getLinkAt compares areas, not perimeters or aspect ratios: under a point inside a tall, a square and a wide link it answers the tall one (the first of the two smallest areas), and off the tall one the wide one, whose area is smaller than the square's though its sides sum higher. A point right of every link, or below every link, answers null.
